generation.initialPrompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: original 2D grain recognition illustration for an agriculture lesson. Create one square illustration of a small loose scattering of uncooked INDICA BROWN RICE grains with bran intact and husks removed. About a dozen separate grains, each distinctly elongated and slender, gently tapered ends, subtle natural lengthwise bran texture; a few varied rotations to show complete outlines. Warm light tan/brown natural bran, not polished white rice, not yellow rough paddy husks, not cooked rice. Clean botanical painted 2D style, restrained fine shading, near-top-down view, soft ivory neutral background, generous margins, every grain fully within frame. Neutral lighting and same scale throughout, no bowl, no mound, no plant, no labels, letters, numbers, scale bar or watermarks. This is a common-appearance example, not an exact cultivar or measured grain ratio. Entirely original arrangement; do not reproduce any book photograph.
generation.correctionPrompt: Precise educational correction: these must read as HULLED, UNPOLISHED BROWN RICE kernels, not rough rice/paddy grains still in straw husks. Preserve the long slender indica outlines, arrangement, complete uncropped composition, ivory background and soft tan botanical 2D palette. Replace the coarse streaky fibrous surfaces with smooth subtly translucent tan bran surfaces, only very fine low-contrast lengthwise lines. Remove straw-like flakes, thick outer ridges or hull seams; round off pointed husk-like tips while retaining elongated rice-kernel shape. Show a small pale embryo notch on some kernels rather than husk tips. No text or scale or extra objects.
generation.reasonForCorrectionJa: 初稿の粗い筋やとがった先端を弱め、もみ殻付きのもみとの混同を減らすため、表面と端の形を修正。
